plans.title: Training Plans
plans.section_desc: Each plan is built from real climbing coaching methodology. Only one plan can be active at a time.
plans.bottom_note: Plans are based on research by Eva López, Eric Hörst, Lattice Training, and Steve Bechtel.
plans.calendar_hint: Works with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar & more
plans.notif_blocked_msg: Enable them in device Settings to get reminders.
plans.cal_blocked_msg: Enable calendar access in device Settings.

plans.cal_error_msg: Could not create calendar events. Check calendar permissions.
plans.error_load_text: Couldn't reach the training server. Check your connection or the API URL in Settings.
plans.empty_text: Your training server hasn't published any plans yet.
plans.tip_tendons: Tendons adapt 3× slower than muscles — never skip rest days.
plans.tip_maxhangs: Max hangs need full rest between reps (3+ min). Quality over quantity.
plans.tip_consistency: Consistency over 12+ weeks beats any single hard session.
plans.tip_warmup: Warm up 15 minutes before any fingerboard work.
plans.tip_pulley: Pain in your A2 pulley means stop immediately and rest 3–5 days.

custom.type_desc_flexibility: Stretching & mobility work. Great for rest days or session warm-downs.
